The added text only points to thm:p15-w02b-p15-022-reverse-strong-law-boundary, thm:p15-w02b-p15-022-backward-changing-boundary, sec:p15-w02b-p15-022-presentable and thm:p15-w02b-p15-022-predictive, which were verified on route and proved. handbook/parts/p15.tex and handbook/annex/p15.tex hashes also differ from the packet reader_evidence.

C016 is stated for Y_n=E(Z|G_n) while Durrett Exercise 4.7.1 is stated for a backward martingale with X_0 in L^p; the identification relies on the tower identity in def:p15-backward-martingale (UB 323-324) and is not restated in the theorem.
The remark that |Y|<=Z almost surely is asserted without its own annex line; it is the immediate limit of |Y_n|<=Z.
'The same last argument' reuses the just-written triviality argument verbatim; acceptable but terse.

C013 uniqueness is given as a special case of directing-law uniqueness without writing the identification of P({0,1}) with [0,1]; a self-contained uniqueness argument for binary mixing laws is written at EA 480-489.

Prose references without labels: 'Bounded optional sampling' (EA 188, thm:p15-bounded-optional-sampling), 'conditional-kernel integration theorem' (EA 370, thm:p15-kernel-expectation), 'real-law selection theorem' (EA 467, thm:p15-helly-selection/thm:p15-weak-tightness-selection), 'measurable-section strong-law argument used for the Polya mixture' (EA 486, polya annex 100-112), 'Conditional dominated convergence' (UA 339, thm:p15-conditional-limits).
